Instrument (EN): FAD-Plus — Italian 27-item adaptation with bifactor ESEM
Scales / measured domains (EN): Free will beliefs (7 original items); Scientific determinism (7); Fatalistic determinism (5); Unpredictability/chance (8). Four belief domains, not a mental-disorder screen.
Research provenance: Fino E & Iliceto P. Current Psychology online 2021-10-23, issue 2023; DOI 10.1007/s12144-021-02268-4. Italian translation in N328 recruited community adults, 51 multivariate outliers removed, analyzed N277; model fit random split n139, gender invariance/criterion split n138 (not two external replications). Conventional four-factor CFA/ESEM poor fit CFI .943 RMSEA .117; bifactor ESEM CFI 1.000 RMSEA 0.000 SRMR .045; omega .91–.98, evidence for configural/threshold/loading gender invariance conditional on bifactor model.

Other translations: IT-IT: translated and psychometrically studied 27-item Italian adult questionnaire, analyzed N277 after exclusion from initial N328. Not a validated Italian clinical diagnostic test.
Target population: Convenience Italian community adults 18–56 from Piedmont and Lazio, N328 initially, N277 analyzed (139 model, 138 invariance); no prospective independent or clinical replication.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Open access article terms do not necessarily release translated questionnaire copyright/scoring and commercial SaaS reproduction.
